title: docs(adr-0066, permissions): Modify All's own-row field vote is kept until the field-axis split
body:
Fixes #33828

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

This is the last item owed on the card after #34082 merged (`3e490335`). It is a docs-only follow-up with two files and nine changed lines. **Tier H**: the diff touches `docs/adr/**`, so it lands only by the maintainer's hand or an authorized approval.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:ADR-0066 D2 ⑧ 2026-11-15 注里关于"修改全部"(Modify All)的那句,从"保持不变,等待裁决"改为"按 #33828 上的裁决 A(「保持现状，只给警告」)保持不变,直到字段轴拆分(#34365)";`field-level-security.mdx` 的默认可见段落补上 #34082 推迟的那一行:权限集自己的 View All 不再解开自己的 `readable: false`,自己的 Modify All 仍然解开(lint 给警告),直到字段轴拆分。
- 为什么改:维护者 2026-11-16 在本卡对 Modify All 选了 A(评论 6909362597);#34365 的裁决(6912661484)要求这句写成"保留到字段轴拆分",不写成"设计如此"。#34082 合并后只剩这两处文字没跟上。
- 风险与回滚:只改文档,不改代码、spec 或 `skills/**`,运行时行为不变,不发版。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md` 第 144 行 2026-11-15 注中加粗的 Modify All 那句(受管文本,本 PR 唯一的风险点);② `content/docs/permissions/field-level-security.mdx` 第 199–208 行。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -n "pending a ruling" origin/main -- docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md` 有 1 处命中,在本分支上同一命令无命中;再打开 mdx 第 203 行,预期看到 "until the field-axis split (#34365)"。
- 需要你做的:审阅 ADR-0066 这一句受管文本,同意后批准或亲自合并(Tier H)。

## What changes

**`docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md`**, the D2 ⑧ note of 2026-11-15, one sentence. Only its bold lead changes:

- Before: `**Modify All is unchanged, pending a ruling:** a set that holds ...`
- After: `**Modify All is unchanged, kept until the field-axis split (#34365), by the maintainer's ruling on the card of 2026-11-16 (6909362597, letter A), verbatim 「保持现状，只给警告」 (keep the current behaviour, warn only):** a set that holds ...`

The rest of the sentence (the set still votes `readable: true` and `editable: true` on every field, its own rows included) and the rest of the note are unchanged. The wording follows cross-link 6912701885 and ruling 6912661484 on #34365: "kept until the field-axis split", not "kept by design". The ruling is quoted in the original Chinese.

**`content/docs/permissions/field-level-security.mdx`**, the default-visible paragraph. This is the line #34082 deferred ("Its sentence that a mask holds unless another set unmasks it does not name the own-set Modify All case; that line belongs with the Modify All ruling"). The sentence's condition gains its own-set half:

- Before: `... or Modify All (modifyAllRecords, reads and edits every field) on that object — so protect sensitive fields ...`
- After: `... on that object, and the set that declares it does not itself hold Modify All on that object: the set's own View All leaves its readable: false binding, while its own Modify All still reads and edits every field of the object, its own rows included (security-superuser-field-mask-inert warns on such a row), until the field-axis split (#34365) — so protect sensitive fields ...`

The paragraph is about the condition under which a mask holds, so it states both own-set cases. The View All clause is the rule #34082 landed.

## Why

- The maintainer ruled A on the Modify All half of the card (6909362597): 「保持现状，只给警告」. Modify All keeps its behaviour, and the warning is the only change.
- Ruling 6912661484 on #34365 sets the end state (record axis and field axis split, a read-only `viewAllFields`). Modify All keeps today's behaviour until that split, so the ADR says "kept until", not "kept by design".
- Hand-off 6912083426 and delivery note 6930255285 name exactly these two items as what the card still owes.

## Verification

Each sentence was checked against the code on `origin/main` (`3bf9c5c41`, which contains `3e490335`):

- **Modify All votes on every field, its own rows included.** `superuserFieldVote` in `packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts` returns `{ readable: true, editable: true }` for any set where `holdsSuperuserBypass(ps, objectName, 'modify')` holds, before the set's own row is read. The own-row check (`declaresOwnReadMask`) runs only on the View All path.
- **The set's own View All leaves its `readable: false` binding.** The same function skips a View All set when `declaresOwnReadMask(ps, objectName, fieldName)` is true. That check reads the set's own `<object>.<field>` row for an explicit `readable === false`.
- **Warn only, no save refused.** `security-superuser-field-mask-inert` in `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts` fires only when `holdsSuperuserBypass(ps, flsObject, 'modify')` holds, and pushes `severity: 'warning'`. The authoring gate refuses on `error` findings only (`authoring-rules.ts`, `errors: findings.filter((f) => f.severity === 'error')`).
